choice.rule: D-056, with D-057's Style A gate: candidates are step 0 (v1) and every checkpoint. Out: any answer in either validation file that the scorer counts invalid or that breaks v1's answer format (judge.reward.read_answer); worst-case precision on valid-hard more than 0.02 below step 0's; worst-case precision or recall on M1 valid more than 0.03 below step 0's. Pick the highest worst-case recall on valid-hard, then the higher worst-case precision there, then the earlier step. Worst case is the lowest of the three versions.

step-100: M1 valid worst-case precision more than 0.03 below step 0
